dialogue_segments.label: THE BEARDED STRANGER (Firm, Menacing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
dialogue_segments.text: Good. Then don't touch her again.

dialogue_segments.label: NOBLE MATRIARCH (Furious, Hysterical)
dialogue_segments.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
dialogue_segments.text: You cannot interfere in a family matter!

dialogue_segments.label: THE BEARDED STRANGER (O.S.) (Stern, Accusing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
dialogue_segments.text: ...when your family is dragging a defenseless woman from a church.

dialogue_segments.label: THE BEARDED STRANGER (Solemn, Gentle)
dialogue_segments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
dialogue_segments.text: You shouldn't have to beg anybody...

dialogue_segments.label: THE BEARDED STRANGER (O.S.) (Honorable, Earnest)
dialogue_segments.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
dialogue_segments.text: You came here to become a wife.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: Juliana softly shakes her head 'no', her wide blue eyes locked onto him.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: The Bearded Stranger sinks to one knee on the cathedral aisle, offering the silver ring up to Juliana.

sound_fx_segments.label: SOUND FX
sound_fx_segments.text: A collective, stunned gasp rippling across the entire congregation.
